name: Amazon Lightsail

evidence.vps: 03: Lightsail instances are virtual private servers; the customer controls the guest OS and app
evidence.paas: 03: managed Linux container services run the customer's container images

line: Simple virtual servers with separate managed database and container options.

free.text: No repeating free VM tier; AWS credits may apply

work.math: $5 a month for the known server cost. Building from source, domain registration and any outside builder cost extra.
The bundle costs at most $7 a month. Builds and the domain are not in this amount.
$7 for the server + $15 for the database = $22 a month. Builds, the domain and tax are not included.
